arguments.value: This agreement is between element 5 GmbH (and its subsidiaries, together referred to as element 5), software publishers who use element 5’s services, and website owners called Affiliates. It sets up an affiliate program in which Affiliates place tracked links and ads for selected software products and earn commission-based advertising cost compensation on qualifying sales referred through their links. Software publishers must approve and activate each Affiliate, set commission rates in the control panel, and may also use element 5’s affiliate management service, for which element 5 charges an additional service fee. element 5 handles the order process, payment collection, refunds, and related administration, while the software publisher provides the products and technical end-user support. Affiliates must use the proper links, keep login credentials confidential, identify themselves as independent partners, and ensure their websites and materials comply with the publisher’s instructions and applicable law. Commissions are generally paid monthly once they reach at least EUR 100 or USD 100, and only for sales completed during the term of the agreement and not canceled or refunded. The agreement starts when the Affiliate Program application is accepted and continues for an unlimited period until either side terminates it at any time, with or without cause, by written notice or through the control panel. The source also says German law applies and Cologne, Germany is the place of jurisdiction.
